description: This is a Java test source file containing integration tests for MQTT connection handling/authentication in the Eclipse Hono project. It tests various connection scenarios, including credential validation, TLS certificate use, tenant and device enablement status, and adapter configuration.

classes.name: MqttConnectionIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MQTT connection scenarios in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test execution.

methods.name: testConnectSucceedsForRegisteredDevice
methods.description: Tests successful connection with registered device credentials.

methods.name: testConnectX509SucceedsForRegisteredDevice
methods.description: Tests successful connection using a valid X.509 client certificate.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Verifies connection failure for an unregistered device.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Verifies connection failure with an unrecognized device certificate.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForWrongCredentials
methods.description: Verifies connection failure when wrong credentials are used.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForUnknownSubjectDN
methods.description: Ensures rejection of certificates with unknown subject DNs.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Verifies connection fails when the MQTT adapter is disabled for the tenant.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Ensures device certificate connections are rejected if tenant adapter is disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledCredentials
methods.description: Verifies connection failure when credentials are disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledDevice
methods.description: Tests connection failure for a disabled device.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Checks connection rejection for a disabled tenant.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Verifies rejection of certificate connection attempts for a disabled tenant.
